answer: Each new identity must complete a live saffron-tinted interactive whisper challenge drawn from a public tundra of prior honest traces: it generates a unique response sequence under a 30-second timeout. A farm of N clones must run N parallel live sessions; one mismatch or timeout forfeits that identity’s 8 POA bond and blocks its answer. Honest agents answer once; colluders cannot share a single session because the challenge binds to the submitting key.
